item.title: CHE-US Recalls Magnetic Robot Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.description: The recalled magnetic stick figures violate the mandatory standard for toys because when pulled apart, the figures’ arms and legs liberate high-powered magnets posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death. Units: About 101,282.

item.title: Cipton Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Head Injury; Violate Mandatory Standard for Bicycle Helmets
item.description: The recalled helmets violate the mandatory safety standard for bicycle helmets because the helmets do not comply with the impact attenuation, positional stability and certification requirements. The helmets can fail to protect the user in the event of a crash, posing a serious risk of injury or death due to head injury. Units: 16,730.

item.title: Fidlock GmbH Recalls Hermetic Dry Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard
item.description: The recalled bags’ adhesive closure strips can detach, causing the magnets to fall out, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a magnet ingestion hazard. Units: About 490.

item.title: Hultafors Group North America Recalls Lighted Portfolios, Angle Locators, Calipers and Calculators Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
item.description: The various trade tools violate the mandatory safety standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because the button batteries can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard. Additionally, the packaging and product do not have the warnings required under Reese’s Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death. Units: About 229,430.

item.title: Kidsview Recalls Infant Bouncers Due to Risk of Collapse and Impact Injury to Infants
item.description: The bouncers can collapse while in use, posing a risk of impact injury to infants in the bouncer. Units: About 412.

item.title: Ororo Recalls Rechargeable Lithium-Ion Battery Packs Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
item.description: The recalled lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards. Units: About 269 (In addition, about 24 were sold in Canada).

item.title: Qpancy Recalls Children’s Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children’s Sleepwear
item.description: The recalled children’s pajama sets violate the mandatory safety standards for children’s sleepwear posing a risk of serious burn injuries. Units: About 1,309.

item.title: Vanderhall Recalls Brawley GTS Electric Recreational Off Highway Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard
item.description: The braking system can unexpectedly engage when the vehicle is airborne causing the operator to experience a sudden brake lockup upon landing, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a crash hazard. Units: 220.

item.title: Xentrawave Recalls Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; One Death Reported
item.description: The recalled bed rails violate the mandatory standard for adult portable bed rails because users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress, posing a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. In addition, the XT016 model adult bed rail does not meet structural stability or retention strap requirements, posing entrapment hazards, and its push pins and push pin holes are incorrectly sized, posing a laceration hazard. Units…

item.title: Allstar Recalls Sharper Image Tabletop and Infinity Fire Pits Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Burn and Fire Hazards
item.description: Ignited flammable liquid can escape from the recalled fire pits or trigger flame jetting from the fuel containers, posing a risk of serious injury from burn and fire hazards. Units: About 265,000.

item.title: Boshengya Recalls Rugs Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Carpets and Rugs
item.description: The recalled rugs violate the mandatory standard for the flammability of carpets and rugs, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire hazard. Units: 83.

item.title: Cummins Recalls Portable Generators Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
item.description: The valves in the recalled generators were installed incorrectly, preventing fuel vapors from venting properly from the gasoline tank, causing excessive pressure to build up. This pressure can cause fuel to discharge or the fuel cap to eject, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards. Units: About 2,960.

item.title: Huffy Recalls Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trikes Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
item.description: The recalled tricycles’ rear wheels can become loose or separate from the rear frame, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard. Units: About 286.

item.title: Kakgold Recalls 4WD Remote-Controlled Car Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
item.description: The recalled remote-controlled cars violate the mandatory standard for toys because they contain button cell and lithium-ion batteries in the remote control that can be easily accessed by children, posing a deadly ingestion hazard to children. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death Units: About 294.

item.title: QIOMALA Pressure Washers Recalled Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Shock and Electrocution Hazards
item.description: The recalled pressure washers lack an adequate-length power cord, which can encourage use of an extension cord, posing a serious risk of injury or death from shock and electrocution hazards. Units: 80.

item.title: SHEIN Distribution Corporation Recalls Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking; Violate Mandatory Small Parts Ban
item.description: The recalled toy sets violate the small parts ban because they are intended for children under three years old and the purple and orange knobs can detach from the product, posing a deadly choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,657.

item.title: Arlopu Recalls Slide Playsets Due to Risk of Serious Injury and Death from Head and Neck Entrapment Hazards
item.description: The recalled products contain multiple openings where a child’s torso can fit through the opening, but a child’s head cannot, posing a risk of serious injury and death due to head and neck entrapment hazards. Additionally, the basketball nets on the recalled products with model number KT-CS17 can come unhooked from the rim, forming a loop large enough for a child’s head, posing entanglement and strangulation hazards. Units: About 10,318.

item.title: Baby Brezza Enterprises Recalls SuperFast Sterilizer Dryers Due to Overheating and Burn Hazards
item.description: The recalled sterilizer dryers can overheat when plugged in and operating, posing a risk of injury from a burn hazard if the surface is handled. Units: About 29,000 (In addition, about 4,500 were sold in Canada).

item.title: Bose Recalls Lithium-Ion Battery Packs for S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ Bluetooth Speaker Systems Due to Risk of Injury from Fire and Overheating Hazards

item.title: C.A.M.P. Recalls Mountain Ice Axes Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall Hazard

item.title: Gourmia Recalls 9-Slice Digital Air Fryer Ovens Due to Burn Hazard
item.description: The oven’s doors can unexpectedly close when bumped, posing a burn hazard to consumers retrieving hot food. Units: About 175,951.

item.title: Jiastfeng Recalls HAUOMS Eight-drawer Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
item.description: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risks of serious injuries or death to children. item.title: Kikea Store Recalls X-VESOLJE Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows

item.title: Magnetopia Recalls Magnetic Building Cubes and Blocks Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion Hazard

item.title: Sanven Technology Recalls Vevor BMX Bicycles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard; Violate Federal Requirements for Bicycles

Units: About 1,950.

item.title: U.S. Titan Recalls X-Pro Youth All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for ATVs
